Vipiṭṭhikatvāna.l: Vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṁ dukhañca, pubbeva ca somanassadomanassan
Vipiṭṭhikatvāna.g: so Paccekasambuddho sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṁ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṁ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṁ catutthaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharatīti vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṁ dukhañca, pubbeva ca somanassadomanassaṁ.
